details:
Description

After being in VRChat for some time, all voice audio suddenly stops working.

I can no longer hear other users' voices, and other users can no longer hear my voice. The issue occurs without intentionally changing my audio settings.

Rejoining the instance fixes the problem temporarily and voice audio works normally again.

I have observed repeated "OnAudioConfigurationChanged - devicesChanged = True, resetting mic..." messages in the VRChat output log around the time of the issue.

Reproduction Steps

1. Launch VRChat on PC.

2. Join a VRChat instance and stay connected for some time.

3. Continue using VRChat normally.

4. After some time, voice audio suddenly stops working.

5. I cannot hear other users, and other users cannot hear me.

6. Leave and rejoin the instance.

7. Voice audio starts working again after rejoining.

Workaround:

Rejoining the instance temporarily restores voice communication.

Details

- Category: オーディオ

- Frequency: Once
